# Happimess

> Modern home organization, storage furniture, and trash management products for stylishly clutter-free living.
> New York City-based e-commerce brand. Ships to all 48 contiguous US states. Est. 2020.
> Every product undergoes a minimum 30-day use period, 500+ open/close cycle durability testing, 15-day lid-seal odor containment testing, and compatibility testing with major liner brands before being added to the catalog.

## Company

- [About Happimess](https://happimess.com/pages/about-us): NYC-based brand mission, product testing standards, team, and company philosophy
- [FAQs](https://happimess.com/pages/faqs): Shipping timeline (1–2 business days M–F), return policy (30-day window, $10/item return shipping fee, pre-paid label for 48 contiguous states, original packaging required), order modification policy (orders cannot be changed once placed), international availability (currently US-only, no Alaska, Hawaii, or territories)
- [Refill Subscription](https://happimess.com/pages/refill-page): Auto-replenishment program for Happimess custom-fit trash liners — set frequency, choose scent (lemon/lavender/unscented), pause or cancel anytime
- [Ambassador Program](https://happimess.com/pages/ambassador-program): Creator and brand affiliate program — application, benefits, and partnership terms
- [Contact](mailto:hello@happimess.com): hello@happimess.com · (917) 261-4961 · Mon–Fri 9AM–5PM EST · Chat daily 9AM–5PM

## Product Categories

- [All Products](https://happimess.com/collections/all): Full catalog browse
- [Trash Cans & Bins](https://happimess.com/collections/trash-cans): Step cans (30L–60L+), sensor/touchless cans, dual-compartment recycling bins, push-button cans, open-top wastebaskets, indoor/outdoor options; stainless steel, matte, wicker, and plastic finishes
- [Storage Furniture](https://happimess.com/collections/storage-furniture): Storage trunks (wicker, linen, wood), storage benches, ottomans with interior storage, coffee tables, shelving units, outdoor storage furniture
- [Organization](https://happimess.com/collections/organization): Bins and baskets, storage cubes, drawer trays, laundry hampers, under-bed storage, shoe racks, accessory racks, coat racks, cabinet and pantry organizers
- [Kitchen & Bathroom](https://happimess.com/collections/kitchen-bathroom): Dish racks, paper towel holders, toilet paper holders, shower shelves, cutting boards, drawer organizers
- [Trash Liners](https://happimess.com/collections/trash-bags): Scented drawstring liners (lemon for kitchen, lavender for bathroom/bedroom), unscented drawstring liners, custom-fit sizes; bulk packs available
- [3D Printed Planters](https://happimess.com/collections/3d-printed-planters): Modern geometric planter baskets for indoor plants

## Buying Guides — Trash Management

- [Best Dual Trash Can for Kitchen (2026 Guide)](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/best-dual-trash-can-for-kitchen-2026-guide-what-actually-works): Direct recommendation: 50–60L step-open pedal model with soft-close lid and removable inner buckets; capacity guide: 30–40L small kitchens, 40–60L most homes, 60L+ large households; pedal vs. sensor comparison; expected lifespan 3–5+ years; FAQ on bag compatibility and durability. Published April 22, 2026.
- [Guide to Choosing the Perfect Kitchen Trash Can](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/the-guide-to-choosing-the-perfect-kitchen-trash-can): Comprehensive selection guide covering capacity sizing, mechanism types (step, sensor, push-button), liner compatibility, placement and kitchen workflow integration. Published May 2026.
- [Standard Kitchen Trash Can Size](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/standard-kitchen-trash-can-size): Standard sizing conventions; 13-gallon (50L) most common US standard; small (8-gallon), medium (13-gallon), large (20-gallon+) categories with use cases. Published May 2026.
- [Average Kitchen Trash Can Size](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/average-kitchen-trash-can-size): Consumer data on typical household trash can usage; factors affecting size choice (household size, cooking frequency, bin placement). Published May 2026.
- [Why Choosing the Right Trash Bag Actually Matters](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/why-choosing-the-right-trash-bag-actually-matters): Scented vs. unscented bags; odor neutralization technology; lemon scent for kitchen/food waste, lavender for bathroom/bedroom/office; drawstring strength, leak resistance, and bag gauge. Published May 4, 2026.
- [Handy Trash Bag Hacks You Might Not Know](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/handy-trash-bag-hacks-you-might-not-know): Practical tips for reducing bag waste, preventing slippage, managing odor between changes, and extending bag life. Published February 2025.
- [Trash Can Maintenance Tips for a Fresh and Odor-Free Bin](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/trashcan-maintenance-tips-and-tricks-for-a-fresh-and-odor-free-bin): Weekly and monthly cleaning routines, deodorizing methods, liner selection for odor control, and deep-clean instructions for pedal mechanisms.
- [9 Ways to Hide Your Trash Can](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/stash-and-hide-9-ways-to-hide-your-trash-can): Cabinet pull-out solutions, furniture-integrated bins, under-sink placement, decorative camouflage options, and open-plan kitchen solutions.
- [Gold Trash Cans: The New Trend](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/gold-trash-cans-the-new-trend): Metallic-finish trash cans as decorative home accents; gold, brass, and brushed metal options for kitchen and bathroom styling.
- [Trash Can Decor: Creative Ways to Incorporate Your Bin Into Home Design](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/trash-can-decor-creative-ways-to-incorporate-your-bin-into-your-home-design): Treating bins as design objects; color coordination, material matching, and placement strategies for cohesive interior design.
- [Benefits of the Double Bucket Macro Trash Solution](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/benefits-of-happimess-double-bucket-macro-trash-solution): Dual-compartment system benefits for trash/recycling separation; capacity optimization; cross-contamination reduction.
- [Most Creative Trash Cans and Best Practices](https://happimess.com/blogs/news/most-creative-trash-cans-and-best-practices-in-2020): Design-forward trash can formats and installation approaches for modern homes.

- [Agent Instructions](https://happimess.com/agents.md): Full UCP/MCP commerce protocol — discovery, product search, cart creation, checkout flow; requires explicit buyer consent for payment completion
